gExpandedPlaceholder_Chan.provenance: The Japanese cart's own row, verbatim: the honorific {KUN} expands to after the player's name (pokefirered/src/string_util.c:386, ExpandPlaceholder_KunChan, by the player's gender). The US cart's row is empty, so the join, which needs an English line, never ships it. gen1recomp does not expand {KUN} in FireRed yet (docs/upstream-fixes.md, FireRed entry 18).

gText_BattleMenu.text: [PALETTE 5][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_SHADOW DYNAMIC_COLOR4 DYNAMIC_COLOR5 DYNAMIC_COLOR6]たたかう[CLEAR_TO 56]バッグ\nポケモン[CLEAR_TO 56]にげる
gText_BattleMenu.provenance: The Japanese cart's own words; only the alignment changes. The cart lines the two columns up with ideographic spaces ("たたかう　　バッグ / ポケモン　　にげる"), where every other cart uses the CLEAR_TO layout code ("FIGHT[CLEAR_TO 56]BAG / POKéMON[CLEAR_TO 56]RUN"). gen1recomp draws the four options in its own grid and splits the row into them at each line break and CLEAR_TO (src/core/game3/battle/ui.lua:2097, menu_labels), so the Japanese row gave it two options holding two words each and left the other two slots empty. The override keeps the words and puts CLEAR_TO 56 where the spaces were, as the US row does.

gText_SafariZoneMenu.provenance: The Japanese cart's own words; only the alignment changes. The cart lines the two columns up with ideographic spaces ("ボール　　　エサだま / いしころ　　にげる"), where every other cart uses the CLEAR_TO layout code ("BALL[CLEAR_TO 56]BAIT / ROCK[CLEAR_TO 56]RUN"). gen1recomp draws the four options in its own grid and splits the row into them at each line break and CLEAR_TO (src/core/game3/battle/ui.lua:2097, menu_labels), so the Japanese row gave it two options holding two words each and left the other two slots empty. The override keeps the words and puts CLEAR_TO 56 where the spaces were, as the US row does.

gText_WhatWillOldManDo.text: おじいさんは\nどうする？
gText_WhatWillOldManDo.provenance: The Japanese cart's own words, broken after は like every other cart's two-line row ("What will the / old man do?"). The Japanese cart prints "おじいさんは　どうする？" on one line in its own, wider prompt window; gen1recomp draws the US window, whose right part the action menu covers (src/core/game3/battle/ui.lua:2123, action_prompt), so the line lost its ending.

gText_WhatWillPkmnDo.provenance: The Japanese cart's own words, broken after は like every other cart's two-line row ("What will / [B_ACTIVE_NAME_WITH_PREFIX] do?"). The Japanese cart prints "[B_ACTIVE_NAME_WITH_PREFIX]は　どうする？" on one line in its own, wider prompt window; gen1recomp draws the US window, whose right part the action menu covers (src/core/game3/battle/ui.lua:2123, action_prompt), so the line lost its ending.

sText_AttackerUsedX.provenance: The cart's row is "[B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX][B_BUFF1]\n[B_BUFF2]": the particle and the ending appended to the move's name depend on the move (ChooseMoveUsedParticle and ChooseTypeOfMoveUsedString, pokefirered/src/battle_message.c:2325, :2365). gen1recomp fills no particle and always appends sText_ExclamationMark (src/core/game3/battle/battle_text.lua:249), so the Japanese overrides give both the values of the moves outside sGrammarMoveUsedTable, most of them: the particle sText_ApostropheS ("の") here, and the ending sText_ExclamationMark5 ("！") under sText_ExclamationMark. The line reads "ポチエナの\nたいあたり！", as the cart prints it for those moves; the same overrides as Emerald's.

sText_ExclamationMark.provenance: The cart's sText_ExclamationMark5 row ("！"), the ending of the moves outside sGrammarMoveUsedTable (pokefirered/src/battle_message.c:2396). gen1recomp appends sText_ExclamationMark to every move's name (src/core/game3/battle/battle_text.lua:249), whose Japanese row is the ending of a small group of moves ("を　つかった！"); see sText_AttackerUsedX.
